name: TOB Bible Battle Answer
description: One row = one player's answer to one question in one battle. Written only by truth_of_bible.api.bible_battle.submit_answer after server-side validation (participant, battle in progress, question matches current index, not already answered, within the time window) — is_correct/points are always computed server-side, never accepted from the client. System-Manager-only permissions; players never read this via direct REST, only through get_battle_status/get_battle_result.

fields.label: Question Index
fields.description: Which of the battle's questions (1-10) this answers — kept alongside the question link for audit even if question_sequence changes shape later.

fields.label: Selected Option
fields.description: Blank means the player did not answer within the time window.

fields.label: Response Time (ms)
fields.description: Server-computed: answered_at minus the battle's question_start_time at submission — never a client-reported duration.

fields.label: Points
fields.description: 100 + speed bonus (0-50) if correct, else 0 — always computed server-side.
